FN-FYIE5D5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 177
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/19/2024
Senate Bill 177 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain municipal gas districts,
paid from district funds, by an estimated $750 per board member per meeting for a maximum of
annual increase in costs of $9,000 per board member.
Page 1
